```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(wordspace)

select <- dplyr::select

```

This notebook is used to find related terms for the app.

## Find nearest neighbour terms


```{r termtermsimilarity, include=TRUE}

# code based on examples here:
# https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/wordspace/vignettes/wordspace-intro.html

d_long <- read_csv(here("data", "foranalyses", "d_long_nounverbadj.csv")) %>% 
  rename(dict = id)

docterm <- d_long %>% select(dict, word, count) %>% 
  filter(count > 0)

VObj <- dsm(target=docterm$word, feature=docterm$dict, score=docterm$count, raw.freq=TRUE)
VObj <- dsm.score(VObj, score="simple-ll", transform="log", normalize=TRUE, method="euclidean")
VObj250 <- dsm.projection(VObj, method="svd", n=250)

d_long_rob <- read_csv(here("data", "foranalyses", "d_long_nounverbadj_robust.csv")) %>% 
  rename(dict = id)

docterm_rob <- d_long_rob %>% select(dict, word, count) %>% 
  filter(count > 0)

VObj_rob <- dsm(target=docterm_rob$word, feature=docterm_rob$dict, score=docterm_rob$count, raw.freq=TRUE)
VObj_rob <- dsm.score(VObj_rob, score="simple-ll", transform="log", normalize=TRUE, method="euclidean")
VObj250_rob <- dsm.projection(VObj_rob, method="svd", n=250)

nns <- function(term) {
  if (term %in% docterm$word) {
    nn_full <- names(nearest.neighbours(VObj250, term, n = 150))
    nn_rob <- names(nearest.neighbours(VObj250_rob, term, n = 150))
    nn_inter <- intersect(nn_full, nn_rob)
    missing_n <- 10 - length(nn_inter)
    
    if (missing_n > 0) {
      extras <- setdiff(nn_full, nn_inter)[1:missing_n]
      nn <- c(nn_inter, extras)
    } else {
      nn <- nn_inter[1:10]
    }
  } else {
    nn <- character(length = 10)
  }
  
  as_tibble(nn) %>% mutate(i = row_number())
}


app_data <-  read_csv(here("output", "results", "bila_app_stats_6000.csv"))

app_nns <- app_data %>% 
  select(word) %>% 
  unique() %>% 
  mutate(neighbours = map(word, nns)) %>% 
  unnest() %>% 
  rename(neighbour = value)

write_csv(app_nns, here("output", "results", "bila_app_nn_6000.csv"))
```

## Find similar languages

```{r termtermsimilarity, include=TRUE}

docterm <- d_long %>%
  group_by(langname_data, word) %>%
  summarise(count = sum(count)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(count > 0)

langs <- unique(docterm$langname_data)

VObj <- dsm(target=docterm$langname_data, feature=docterm$word, score=docterm$count, raw.freq=TRUE)
VObj <- dsm.score(VObj, score="simple-ll", transform="log", normalize=TRUE, method="euclidean")
VObj50 <- dsm.projection(VObj, method="svd", n=50)


nls <- function(lang) {
  if (lang %in% docterm$langname_data) {
    nn <- names(nearest.neighbours(VObj50, lang, n = 10))
  } else {
    nn = character(length=10)
  }
  as_tibble(nn) %>% mutate(i = row_number())
} 

app_nl <- tibble(langs)%>% 
  mutate(neighbours = map(langs, nls)) %>% 
  unnest(cols = c(neighbours)) %>% 
  rename(neighbour = value)

write_csv(app_nl, here("output", "results", "bila_app_nl.csv"))
```
